select '${statusValidE}' effectStatus, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bussId,
FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID ptlId,
FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.SALE_DEPARTMENT saleDepartment,
case when FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode10} or FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode12} then TO_CHAR(TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd') else '' end as sonId,
PRD_SALE_PARAM.FIRST_SALE_VDATE firstSaleVdate, PRD_SALE_PARAM.FIRST_SALE_MDATE firstSaleMdate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE vdate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.MDATE mdate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_AMT currentSubscribe, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_AMT arrivalCapital, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.ps dealType FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL on TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT on TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE='02' left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID left join PRD_SALE_PARAM on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRD_SALE_PARAM.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_OPEN_PLAN on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE = FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_VDATE
left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY
on FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID
where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{dealStatusInit} and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.IS_CANCEL = #{yesNoNo} and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.PS IN ('C1','C2')
and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodTypeProd} and FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE >= to_date(#{vdateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SETTLE_DATE <= to_date(#{vdateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
